resumeText:
Mohammed Imran | Hyderabad | m.imran@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Senior AR Executive, Golconda Revenue Partners (fictional), Hyderabad (2022 - present)
- Call insurance payers to follow up on unpaid claims for a US multispecialty physician group.
- Work Medicare, Medicaid and commercial payer accounts and track timely filing limits.
- Analyse denials such as CO-16 and CO-197 and file appeals with corrected documentation.
- Read EOBs and ERAs to identify underpayments and request reprocessing.
- Update claim notes in athenahealth and eClinicalWorks practice management systems.
- Handle PHI as per HIPAA guidelines on every call and email.

AR Caller, Golconda Revenue Partners (fictional), Hyderabad (2020 - 2022)
- Explained claim status and denial reasons to payer representatives on US-shift calls.
- Prepared the daily AR ageing summary for the team lead.

EDUCATION
BCom, Osmania University, 2020

SKILLS
Eligibility verification, MS Excel, US healthcare RCM
